subject: Leaflet: clearMarkers() not removing points with updateSelectInput()

messages.author: 85509014f9eb767e
messages.subject: Leaflet: clearMarkers() not removing points with updateSelectInput()
parts:
Hi

I have a leaflet shiny app in which a subset of points are plotted according to a selectInput(), which works great.

However, when I try replacing the selectInput() with an updateSelectInput(), to allow me to filter the options to a shorter list, clearMarkers() no longer removes points. Instead, each set of points is plotted on top of the previous set.

Please see example below. What am I missing?

Thanks




library(shiny)
library(leaflet)

# this works

quakes$stationsgrp<-cut(quakes$stations, breaks=5, labels=seq(1:5))


runApp(list(ui=pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Example"),
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("stn", "Choose station", choices=unique(quakes$stations))
  ),
  mainPanel(
    leafletOutput("map"))
)
,

server=function(input, output, session){
  
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({ 
    
    leaflet(quakes)  %>%
      addTiles()  %>%
      fitBounds(~min(long), ~min(lat), ~max(long), ~max(lat))
  })
  
  observe({
    quakes1<-quakes[quakes$stations==input$stn,]
    
    leafletProxy("map", data=quakes1) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      addCircleMarkers() 
  })
  
  
}
)
,launch.browser=T)



# this doesn't work - points not clearing 

## create stations group for filtering
quakes$stationsgrp<-cut(quakes$stations, breaks=5, labels=seq(1:5))


runApp(list(ui=pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Example"),
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("var", "Station group", choices=levels(quakes$stationsgrp)),
    selectInput("stn", "Choose station", choices="subChoice")
  ),
  mainPanel(
    leafletOutput("map"))
)
,


server=function(input, output, session){
  subChoice<-reactive({
    switch(input$var,      
           "1" = unique(quakes$stations[quakes$stationsgrp==1]),
           "2" = unique(quakes$stations[quakes$stationsgrp==2]),
           "3" = unique(quakes$stations[quakes$stationsgrp==3]),
           "4" = unique(quakes$stations[quakes$stationsgrp==4]),
           "5" = unique(quakes$stations[quakes$stationsgrp==5])         
    )
  })
  observe({
    updateSelectInput(session,
                      "stn",
                      label="Choose station",
                      choices=c(subChoice())
    )
  })
  
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({ 
    
    leaflet(quakes)  %>%
      addTiles()  %>%
      fitBounds(~min(long), ~min(lat), ~max(long), ~max(lat))
  })
  
  observe({
    quakes1<-quakes[quakes$stations==input$stn,]
    
    leafletProxy("map", data=quakes1) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      addCircleMarkers()
    
    
  })
  
  
}
)
,launch.browser=T)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Leaflet: clearMarkers() not removing points with updateSelectInput()
parts:
It seems there is a bug that when you call addCircleMarkers (and presumably other similar layer functions) but there are actually no circles to add (i.e. nrow(quakes1) == 0), the JavaScript layer tries to add a circle marker with null coordinates and this causes an exception at a bad time. This causes all future attempts to clear shapes to fail.

You can work around this for now by changing your last observer to this:

    observe({
      quakes1<-quakes[quakes$stations==input$stn,]

      map <- leafletProxy("map", data=quakes1)
      map %>% clearMarkers()
      
      if (nrow(quakes1) > 0)
        map %>% addCircleMarkers()
    })

messages.subject: Re: Leaflet: clearMarkers() not removing points with updateSelectInput()
parts:
Hi all,

I also encountered this issue and found this post, but unfortunately couldn't replicate the workaround successfully.
Here is the relevant portion of my server code:

  output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(provider="OpenMapSurfer.Roads") %>%
      setView(lng = -0.1277583, lat = 51.50735, zoom=13) %>%
      addMarkers(lng = -0.1277583, lat = 51.50735) %>% #data=points()
      addCircleMarkers(data = data_raw, color = ~pal(data_raw$price), popup = as.character(htmlEscape(data_raw$price)), radius = 5, opacity = 0.7)
      })

  observeEvent(input$recalc,{

    filteredData <- data_raw[data_raw$type == input$type,]
    mymap<-leafletProxy("mymap", data=filteredData)
    mymap %>% clearMarkers()

    if (nrow(filteredData) > 0) {
      mymap %>% addCircleMarkers(data = filteredData, color = pal(filteredData$price), popup = as.character(htmlEscape(filteredData$price)), radius = 5, opacity = 0.7)
    }
     

my filtereData actually never comes back empty, so it makes sense that it didn't work.
To make it as similar as I could to the workaround I also omitted addMarkers(..) and addCircleMarkers(..) from the first part where the map is created to see if it has any effect - and it didn't. In fact - the first points from the map's initialization do get cleared, but from then on any filtering just adds markers and doesn't remove any.

Is there another possible workaround?

Thanks!
Alona
